title: Vibrant Earthy Vietnamese Fish Ca Kho To
description: A pescatarian friendly Vietnamese dish featuring marinated fish cooked in a cast iron skillet, perfect for a post workout meal. This earthy and crumbly Ca Kho To is made with pecorino and served with steamed vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the cast iron skillet over medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the fish fillets to the marinade and coat evenly.
Let the fish marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the fish from the marinade and cook in the preheated skillet for 4 minutes per side.
While the fish is cooking, mix the crumbled pecorino cheese with chopped scallions.
Once the fish is cooked, top each fillet with the pecorino and scallion mixture.
Serve the fish hot with steamed vegetables.
Garnish with additional scallions and pecorino cheese if desired.
